t: Look up at the clock tower in Market Square on Chrisp Street, in Poplar. It is Grade II listed. Frederick Gibberd designed it as part of the Lansbury Estate for the Festival of Britain in 1951. It is an example of early post-war architecture, in what became known as the Festival Style. Gibberd was an architect, town planner and landscape designer, best known for Liverpool Metropolitan Cathedral and his work in Harlow, Essex.
